resources.string: Gives Switchly the control needed for optional advanced device-admin and managed-device features.
Disabling the Switchly device admin removes its advanced managed-device hooks. On normal personal devices this is only an advanced helper and not true uninstall protection.
Standard personal app mode.\nNo managed-device ownership is active.

This screen is for advanced users who want to experiment with Android enterprise-style management via ADB.\nOn normal personal devices, Switchly can only add uninstall friction.\nStronger uninstall blocking requires managed-device ownership and is not the normal consumer setup.
For almost everyone, Switchly’s uninstall friction is the right option.\nUse this screen only if you explicitly want to test Device Admin, profile-owner, or device-owner flows.

Device-owner commands usually only work on a freshly provisioned device with no existing accounts.
Profile-owner commands have their own provisioning limits.
Device Admin is limited and does not equal full managed-device ownership.
Use this only if you know what you are doing.
This only enables Switchly’s optional advanced admin receiver.\nIt does not guarantee uninstall blocking on a normal personal device.

Open the official Android DevicePolicyManager reference.
Hide the extra advanced entry again.\nYou can still come back later by long pressing the version row.
